integrity: The primary open PDF was inspected at Proposition 1, Eqs. (2.9)-(2.13), Theorem 3.1, the PGF/MGF section, and the stress-strength derivation. The earlier Poisson-XLindley reliability paper was inspected for related survival/hazard coverage. The coefficient correction was derived from the PMF tail sum and independently replayed from the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the printed survival, CDF, hazard, and CDF-based stress-strength formulas; it does not challenge the defining PMF or PGF.
The article's figures may have been generated by separate numerical code, so their exact computational provenance is not inferred.
A very recent unindexed correction could exist outside the sources examined.
title: The PTS-XL survival coefficient is wrong and the printed hazard can exceed one
